summary: A short one-page specimen for a free COLRv1 isometric colour font: alternating blue specimen bands and grey two-column prose bands, an annotated COLRv0-vs-COLRv1 diagram, an axis demo with Depth/Highlight sliders, and a full customizer with axis sliders, palette select and ten per-layer colour pickers. Everything leads to Google Fonts and GitHub.

instances.learn: Use a word that names the font's concept (here 'Isometry') instead of the family name, and draw the concept's own grid behind it
